thesis: The deepest storage build in the set on the thinnest secured revenue: no capacity market, a tender floor whose level is unpublished, and a merchant spread at a record low as the fleet passed 9,000 MW. At build cost the reference project returns about 4.5%, so the case is the entry price, not the build. Four hours, on a tender award or a toll.
